Game Overview

Super Sucker 3D is a casual title where dive into vibrant 3D worlds where your vacuum is your greatest ally. Absorb everything in your path, launching objects at cunning foes and formidable bosses. Solve intricate puzzles, unlock secrets, and discover hidden treasures. With easy controls and exciting challenges, your cleaning adventure awaits!
